events.name: Bingo Loco
events.info: Get ready as Bingo Loco is crashing into Harrisburg nightlife with a wild mix of bingo, music, and party like nothing you have seen before. Picture this: Energetic MCs, DJ-spun throwbacks, mountains of confetti, and crowd-hyping CO2 cannons, all while you play high-stakes bingo for outrageously fun prizes. Whether you are planning a night out with friends, a birthday celebration, or looking for a unique event in Harrisburg, this is the party you do not want to miss.
